footnote_text: On September 30, 2026,  the trustee of a grantor retained annuity trust for which the reporting person serves as the voting agent, made a scheduled annuity distribution of 657,779 shares held by such trust to the grantor of the trust in satisfaction of an annuity payment obligation pursuant to the terms of the trust. || The shares are held in grantor retained annuity trusts for which the reporting person serves as the voting agent.
